subject: pathology
title: Lung Squamous Carcinoma, Adenocarcinoma EGFR ALK, Small Cell Carcinoma, and Neuroendocrine Markers

steps.tx: Squamous cell carcinoma of lung grows centrally in smokers' bronchi with keratin pearls and intercellular bridges, cavitating, obstructing, and secreting PTHrP into hypercalcaemia more than other lung cancers. The central keratinising cancer is **pulmonary squamous cell carcinoma**. This point is tested repeatedly because it changes everyday bedside decisions.
steps.say: Central, cavitating, keratinising, hypercalcaemic: squamous lung cancer in smokers, four clues at once.

vis.caption: Lung carcinoma patterns across squamous, adeno, and small cell types.

steps.tx: Hypercalcaemia in lung cancer usually means squamous histology secreting parathyroid hormone related protein, while adenocarcinoma prefers hyponatraemia less and small cell owns SIADH and Cushing syndromes. That endocrine sorting is **paraneoplastic patterns by lung histology**. Examiners return to it because it separates careful clinicians from guesswork.
steps.say: Calcium up suggests squamous, sodium down suggests small cell; paraneoplastic chemistry sorts lung histology.

steps.tx: Adenocarcinoma, commonest lung cancer overall and in never smokers, grows peripherally as glands or mucin producers and carries druggable EGFR, ALK, ROS1, and KRAS alterations demanding molecular profiling. The peripheral glandular cancer is **lung adenocarcinoma, molecularly profiled**. Bedside recognition of this pattern saves time, blood, and unnecessary investigation.
steps.say: Every lung adenocarcinoma earns EGFR, ALK, and wider profiling; histology alone no longer prescribes.

left.title: EGFR mutated
points: Never or light smokers, Asian enrichment

steps.tx: Small cell carcinoma crushes blue small cells with scant cytoplasm, nuclear moulding, and necrosis from heavy smoking exposure, doubling fast, metastasising early, and answering chemotherapy briefly before relapse. The neuroendocrine sprinter is **small cell lung carcinoma**. Students should anchor this fact before moving to rarer causes and exceptions.
steps.say: Crush artefact, moulded nuclei, huge nodes, paraneoplasia: small cell carcinoma runs fastest and relapses hardest.

steps.tx: Neuroendocrine markers chromogranin, synaptophysin, CD56, and INSM1 stain small cell and carcinoid tumours, while TTF1 supports lung origin in both small cell and adenocarcinoma contexts. That panel performs **neuroendocrine differentiation in lung tumours**. In practice this distinction decides the next test, treatment, or referral made.
steps.say: Synaptophysin, chromogranin, CD56: neuroendocrine stains separate small cell and carcinoid families.

steps.tx: Large cell carcinoma diagnoses exclusion in large peripheral undifferentiated tumours lacking glandular, squamous, or neuroendocrine commitment after full panels, increasingly dissolved into molecular categories. The shrinking wastebasket is **large cell lung carcinoma, diagnosis of exclusion**. That is why this detail earns its place in every examination and ward round.
steps.say: Large cell carcinoma shrinks as panels grow; undifferentiated today is molecularly classified tomorrow.

steps.tx: Targeted therapy transformed adenocarcinoma: EGFR inhibitors, ALK and ROS1 inhibitors, KRAS G12C drugs, and immunotherapy by PD-L1 now sequence by molecular report like a menu. That report driven practice is **molecular sequencing of lung adenocarcinoma therapy**. Remembering it prevents the commonest errors made with this presentation entirely.
steps.say: Read the molecular report before the chemotherapy chart in lung adenocarcinoma; drivers order first.

nodes.label: EGFR, ALK, ROS1, KRAS, PD-L1 profiled

steps.tx: Smoking prevention and cessation remain lung cancer's largest therapy, cutting squamous and small cell incidence most, while screening low dose CT saves selected heavy smokers' lives. That hierarchy defines **lung cancer prevention and screening priorities**. The clinical payoff comes from applying it early, before complications accumulate further.
steps.say: No targeted drug outperforms never smoking; low dose CT screening serves those already heavily exposed.
